findings.rationale: Folded in r3 §2.1: the count predicate is back on the stream population P (fetchSince/fetchPendingSince ∩ deliverable), pending = |P ∩ chat|, replayed_exempt = |P \ chat|; the plan no longer claims pending equals the poll count — poll returns a superset and the summary wording says so. T6 now asserts pending + replayed_exempt == message events without replay_max; T14 counts are consistent.

Folded in r3 §2.1/§2.3: one population definition for both branches — since-resume uses fetchSince, cold start uses fetchPendingSince (delivered_at IS NULL), both ∩ deliverable; the poll-predicate rule is withdrawn; resume_since is carried in the event ("" on cold start) so the harness always has a since to poll from; T5 fixture now includes stamped historical rows.

Folded in r3 §1: only kind === 'chat' is summarized; every other kind (task_dispatch, task_result, permission_request, permission_verdict) is always replayed, citing the trackers in inbound.ts:141-183 and tools.ts:582-612; T14 adds a permission_verdict row.

Folded in r3 §2.2/§2.4: event order is backlog (peer-agent persists pendingBacklog, cursor untouched) → exempt rows one by one (cursor advances per row as today) → backlog_end (only then cursor := newest). A mid-way disconnect leaves the cursor at the last exempt row, so exempt rows are never lost and the cursor never passes an unpersisted summary; T14b covers the disconnect.

Folded in r3 §2.5 and P4: inbox-spool.ts is now in scope; mergeInboxPage passes pending_after/pending_capped through and adds the truncated count to pending_after when the union is cut; T18 covers it.

Folded in r3 §2.4 step 3: multiple batches merge (since = min, count summed, newest = latest); clearing requires a poll whose since <= stored since AND next_cursor >= newest; pending_after no longer updates the count (different predicate); T20 covers it.

Folded: R-a scan bounds defined in §2.1 (single pass, cap 10 000, H = last scanned id); R-b fixed in §2.2 (@team rows count only under the "@team" key, direct rows under from — the example arithmetic now holds); R-c accepted with wording; R-d strict rule in §2.4 (target only when present, else all).
